messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-98765 fired for host gpu-host-17 (us-west2). Symptom: kernel panic followed by kubelet NotReady. Impact: elevated 5xx on inference routes for a subset of customers. Auto-escalate in 3m if unacked. https://pagerduty.example/INC98765

jana (oncall): ACK. I'm on it — attaching to serial console now. :coffee:

marc (sre): grabbing serial logs and dmesg. If it's a driver kernel oops we may need RMA.

isabel (infra): I'll open a colo support ticket and check BMC reachability.

marc (sre): serial excerpt: 
```
[ 220.112233] NVRM: GPU HANG: Xid 79, GPU 0000:af:00.0
[ 220.112244] NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 220.112255] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
[ 220.112266] Call Trace:
  ...
```
This looks like an Xid79 GPU hang -> kernel panic sequence.

jana (oncall): Running immediate mitigation: `kubectl cordon gpu-host-17` then `kubectl drain gpu-host-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=30`. Notifying platform to reroute traffic.

tom (platform): Starting traffic shift: reduce primary us-west2 routing to 30% and spin up extra capacity in us-west1 fallback pool. Also flagging model-serving routes for degraded latency if they hit the fallback.

claire (product): I can draft a short status page blurb: "Some requests in us-west2 may get 5xx. We're shifting traffic to fallback region and working on the affected host. No customer data loss expected." Will hold until you confirm fallback stable.

isabel (infra): Colo ticket CT-202604 created. BMC reachable, tech on standby; requesting RMA for GPU board. Estimated on-site replace in 3 hours.

marc (sre): After cordon/drain: a handful of pods failed to restart cleanly and returned 503s briefly: `predictor-a-9`, `batch-transform-5`. Autoscaler provisioning new node gpu-host-23 (replacement) now.

jana (oncall): BMC soft power cycle initiated: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H bmc-gpu-17 -U admin -P **** chassis power cycle`

incident-bot: Power cycle accepted, monitoring boot.

marc (sre): Host booted but kubelet fails with kernel oops during module init. Kubelet logs show NVME/GPU init error then exit.

isabel (infra): Marking host with `redwood/maintenance=true` label and keeping it cordoned. RMA ticket updated RMA-2026-778. On-site tech confirmed next steps: board swap then 2-hour burn test.

tom (platform): Traffic shift looks stable; error rate for critical routes returned to baseline ~10m after mitigation. I'll keep the fallback replicas warmed for 1 hour to avoid flapping.

claire (product): Posting status update now. Message: "Mitigation in progress. Affected host at us-west2 experienced a GPU-triggered kernel panic; traffic routed to fallback region. Engineers are replacing hardware. We'll update when replacement completes."

marc (sre): Quick root-cause hypothesis recorded: possible GPU driver/hardware fault causing Xid79 hang -> kernel panic. Action: hold image/driver changes for this cohort until we confirm.

jana (oncall): Leaving monitoring on for 45m. Creating follow-up ticket for postmortem and driver gating: PM-3456.

isabel (infra): Autoscaler created gpu-host-23 and pods have been rescheduled. No further 5xx spikes observed.

marc (sre): Added alert rule: detect Xid79 > 3/min on a rack to trigger early paging. Also will add a runbook note to check BMC logs and GPU Xid patterns.

claire (product): Thanks team. I'll coordinate comms with customer success for any affected customers.

incident-bot: PD-98765 status: acknowledged -> monitoring. Will auto-escalate if not resolved in 45m.

jana (oncall): Closing active paging for this thread. Will reopen if RMA or image changes reveal follow-up. Opening postmortem ticket and will link here when created. Good work. :white_check_mark:

(END)
